ameya: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing we extract a small runtime-sheen adapter to own input canonicalization and backward-compat shims. small surface, high-safety. thoughts?
jordan: what's the exact boundary vs request-router?
ameya: sheen sits after router before runtimes. it handles: canonicalizing timestamps/legacy fields, policy-driven response shaping (truncate/map headers), and shims for old model variants. NOT routing or auth/quotas.
lia: keep auth upstream. if sheen calls auth, latency risk.
sam: how avoid extra RPC hop adding latency?
ameya: rollout plan: start in-process module behind feature flag, then network service later. in-proc avoids immediate perf tax.
jordan: or single binary with pluggable sheen interface to keep deploy simple.
lia: encrypter sidecar taught us in-proc + flag is smooth.
sam: ops: guard for memory growth; sheen will have small caches, add eviction and mem metrics.
devon: cutover checkpoints: regression prompt smoke tests, latency baseline vs canary, rollback thresholds (p95 +0.8s OR error rate +2%). I'll own dashboard/alerts.
ameya: rollout steps: spike -> inproc flag -> canary region -> global. sample: SERVICE_RUNTIME_FLAGS=--sheen=inproc; run curl smoke tests.
jordan: compatibility matrix mapping old->canonical field names should live in sheen repo as markdown + unit tests.
lia: add tenant opt-in allowlist for shims; enterprise may opt out.
sam: observability: tag traces/spans when sheen mutates payloads.
devon: will add span "sheen.transform" and sheen.transform.count metric with labels {tenant,transform_type}.
ameya: policy: sheen may annotate but must NOT enforce auth/quotas. router/policy plane owns that.
jordan: tests: e2e harness that runs regression prompts both with and without sheen to assert equivalence within config bounds.
ameya: I'll draft RFC follow-up + compatibility matrix by EOD. @devon can you create dashboard and rollback alerts?
devon: on it; will post link here.
deploy-bot: Provisional canary window scheduled 2023-10-04 22:00 UTC (sheen-inproc). Owners must ack 24h before.
lia: ack.
jordan: ack.
sam: ack.
ameya: thanks team; dropping follow-up RFC and checklist in repo tonight.
